video_title: Team USA Pressure, Liberty Resurgence & Stewie Passes Her Idol

quotes.speaker: Breanna Stewart
quotes.summary_phrase: Breanna Stewart on the honor of playing for Team USA
quotes.excerpt: It's an incredible honor to be able to wear USA across my chest anytime I get the opportunity.
quotes.quote: It's an incredible honor to be able to wear USA across my chest anytime I get the opportunity. This will be my fourth World Cup, which is kind of crazy thinking about when I first started. I played my first one when I was going into my junior year in college, and now to be at my fourth, being more of a vet of the group, we have some newcomers and I'm so excited to continue to show them the ropes.

quotes.speaker: Myles Turner
quotes.summary_phrase: Myles Turner on the challenge of playing for Team USA
quotes.excerpt: There's only one ball in that court, and I think that's what fans don't realize.
quotes.quote: I got a chance playing in the World Cup in 2019, and we played in five or six different cities in China. We had one of the worst finishes ever, we didn't even medal. But it was still an amazing experience just to put your own ego to the side. I think that's what fans don't realize. On paper, an incredible roster. You have All-Stars, you have future Hall of Famers. There's only one ball in that court, and you have to figure out a way to win because the people you're playing against, they're a cohesive team.

quotes.speaker: Breanna Stewart
quotes.summary_phrase: Breanna Stewart on the unwritten rules of Team USA basketball
quotes.excerpt: Whenever you all come together, put your ego aside, whatever you did for your W team doesn't matter.
quotes.quote: It's almost like this unwritten rule or this kind of rite of passage with USA basketball. Whenever you all come together, put your ego aside, whatever you did for your W team doesn't matter. We just want to come in and make sure that we're the best, and we play well together, and we really share the ball. It's a lot of fun because there's a level of respect and cohesiveness where we're just trying to find the best shot, find the most open look, and gel together defensively.

quotes.speaker: Breanna Stewart
quotes.summary_phrase: Breanna Stewart on the tight schedule of the World Cup
quotes.excerpt: Our last game is August 29th, the tournament starts September 22nd.
quotes.quote: Our last game is August 29th, the tournament starts September 22nd. You get to Berlin the 31st, you got what, three days of practice, and then the show's on the road. It's never an easy competition, but it'll be tough for everybody this year with the international talent that's in the WNBA all over the place. Everybody's going to get late.

quotes.speaker: Myles Turner
quotes.summary_phrase: Myles Turner on the pressure of playing for Team USA
quotes.excerpt: You're expected to win every single game.
quotes.quote: You're expected to win every single game. I remember we were playing against Turkey and the entire game, all the Chinese fans, Turkey, yay, Turkey, yay, the entire game. And it actually ended up going to overtime, and Jason Tatum ended up hitting a crazy shot. But then we're up two with about 10 seconds, it's USA, USA, so they flip like real quick. Nobody, everybody wants to see you lose, and that's just a different type of pressure.

quotes.speaker: Breanna Stewart
quotes.summary_phrase: Breanna Stewart on the 'gold or bust' mentality of Team USA
quotes.excerpt: Especially with USA basketball, it's gold or bust. That's literally it.
quotes.quote: Especially with USA basketball, it's gold or bust. That's literally it. But you embrace those moments. You embrace the hard, you embrace everybody cheering against you. We felt it on another level at the Paris Olympics when we were playing France in the gold medal game in France. That was a crazy atmosphere, but you want to be in those spots. You want to be in those places.

quotes.speaker: Breanna Stewart
quotes.summary_phrase: Breanna Stewart on the top international competition for Team USA
quotes.excerpt: France should be really good. We have three French players on my New York team.
quotes.quote: France should be really good. We have three French players on my New York team, Pauline, Marine Johannes, and Marine Fauthoux. China will be tough because their size is incredible to match up with, and we have Han Xu on my team. Germany, in Germany, because you never bet against the home team. Australia is getting back into their rhythm, Spain will be young, Belgium, they always have a great core together. It's going to be tough.

quotes.speaker: Myles Turner
quotes.summary_phrase: Myles Turner on Breanna Stewart passing Candace Parker on scoring list
quotes.excerpt: Stewie just passed Candace Parker, moving to 10th on the all-time WNBA scoring list.
quotes.quote: Stewie just passed Candace Parker, moving to 10th on the all-time WNBA scoring list. Top 10 scorer in WNBA history. How cool was it to pass Candace? We all grew up watching her. Everybody knows who she is. Even if you don't watch hoops, you know who Candace Parker is. And she was actually calling the game that you passed her. Just talk about that experience.

quotes.speaker: Breanna Stewart
quotes.summary_phrase: Breanna Stewart on passing her idol Candace Parker
quotes.excerpt: Candace is my idol, growing up playing basketball she's who I modeled my game after.
quotes.quote: Candace is my idol, growing up playing basketball she's who I modeled my game after. I had no idea that I passed her. I had no idea I was even close. I saw her in the hallway after the game and she was like, congrats on breaking the top 10. And I was like, for what? I didn't know what we were talking about. And she was like, you passed me on the all-time scoring list. And I was like, wow. Incredible honor to be able to have her call the game and be pass her at the same time.

quotes.speaker: Myles Turner
quotes.summary_phrase: Myles Turner on Breanna Stewart's pursuit of Sue Bird's record
quotes.excerpt: Also closing in on number nine, one of your former teammates and one of your friends, Sue Bird.
quotes.quote: Also closing in on number nine, one of your former teammates and one of your friends, Sue Bird. You're only about 150 points away from her and getting that nice spot. What would it mean to pass Sue, just knowing the relationship you all got?

quotes.speaker: Breanna Stewart
quotes.summary_phrase: Breanna Stewart on closing in on Sue Bird's scoring record
quotes.excerpt: A few games ago I got my 1000th assist. Took me 10 seasons to get 1000 assists.
quotes.quote: A few games ago I got my 1000th assist. Took me 10 seasons to get 1000 assists. And I texted Sue, I said, I'm only 2,300 away from breaking your record. And she was like, yeah, you would have to average four assists for the next 600 games to pass me. So I was like, all right, that's not possible. To be able to be closing in on her record, Sue is a legend, she's my vet, the person that I looked up to. Really happy to have shared the court with her with so many different teams and levels. I just hope that she's in the crowd too when it happens.

quotes.speaker: Breanna Stewart
quotes.summary_phrase: Breanna Stewart on the New York Liberty's recent success
quotes.excerpt: We've won six out of our last seven games.
quotes.quote: We're feeling good. Things are rolling pretty well with us. We've won six out of our last seven games. And I think what the difference is, is sometimes, I think we talked about this earlier, we just needed to get to All-Star break. We needed to get to that moment to reset and get away and come back and really lock in together. We started with a road trip, a West Coast swing, we finished two and one. We've now won our last two at home. So we're just trying to build.

quotes.speaker: Myles Turner
quotes.summary_phrase: Myles Turner on Breanna Stewart's aggressive playstyle
quotes.excerpt: When you make yourself a focal point, when you're aggressive, the team is just different.
quotes.quote: When you make yourself a focal point, when you're aggressive, the team is just different. And it's just from a pure fan's perspective. Obviously Sabrina runs the show, you have JJ, you have a squad around you. But when you're more, I guess when you're constantly trying to score more, good things happen. Does that ever come across your mind? Because I know you're such a team-oriented player, but like, when you go to that flow state, it's not really much anybody in the league can do with you.

quotes.speaker: Breanna Stewart
quotes.summary_phrase: Breanna Stewart on shifting to a more aggressive scoring mindset
quotes.excerpt: I'm just going and taking it. I'm not waiting for it to come to me.
quotes.quote: It's funny you say that because someone else said that to me recently. And I think that what I have been trying to do is, you know, sometimes you start the game and you're just like, all right, I'm going to see how this goes. I'm going to flow into it and I can get my rhythm in the first quarter, I can get my rhythm in the third quarter, I know it's going to come. But what I'm doing now, or like I feel like what I've been doing, especially as of late, is I'm just going and taking it. I'm not waiting for it to come to me. I'm going to go take it and be aggressive and set that standard of how this game is going to go throughout the entire 40 minutes.

quotes.speaker: Breanna Stewart
quotes.summary_phrase: Breanna Stewart on the challenges of potty training her son
quotes.excerpt: We're trying to potty train our son Theo. Oh my god. Potty training a boy is so difficult.
quotes.quote: We're trying to potty train our son Theo. Oh my god. Potty training a boy is so difficult. Literally, like I'm trying to, so he's tall, right? But like I don't want to teach him to stand right away because well then what are we going to do if he poops, right? So I'm trying to put him on the toilet, so he's I'm having him face in, in the toilet, like so he's facing the wall at the toilet, so then like so then it's like aiming down, right? Because if he's facing out, it might go up or down and pee is just going to go everywhere.

quotes.speaker: Breanna Stewart
quotes.summary_phrase: Breanna Stewart on Hillary Clinton attending her game
quotes.excerpt: Hillary Clinton was at my game on Monday. That was insane.
quotes.quote: Hillary Clinton was at my game on Monday. That was insane. Like she got up and she had like an like an incredible roar from the fans. Like usually like politicians don't have that insane of a crowd roar. And that was nuts. Like she got up and she was just like this and I was like, you're amazing. But then what happened the next on yesterday, and a win tour was there.
